notes: This is the focused Pulse pilot suite, not full-chain coverage.
Provide one runner request inline to a fresh native replay; never distribute the judge packet or prior results to the replay.
Record the exact model ID, model version, reasoning effort, and runtime for every finalized run; missing profile metadata is a certification failure.
Capture the exact request and response; judge frozen criteria outside the replay context. Missing profile or trace metadata stays diagnostic and cannot authorize promotion.
Use --legacy-audit with a fresh output workspace for historical v3 evidence; preserve existing archives.
